fusions.name: Loose When Ready
fusions.desc: An arrow loosed at a target up to 9 tiles away that deals 4 damage, rising to 2 times that at full reach, and slows the target by 20% for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: The Long Hold
fusions.desc: After a 2-second draw, fires an arrow that deals 34 damage to the first enemy it meets and ignores its armour.

fusions.name: No Need to Walk
fusions.desc: After a 1.5-second cast, your attacks and spells reach 40% further for 30 seconds.

fusions.name: Tension Kept
fusions.desc: After 10 seconds without a critical hit, your crit chance rises by 40% for your next strike. Once every 10 seconds.
